title: Your own visual language
intro: Choose images, review suggestions and save an independent style. Existing styles stay unchanged.
drop: Drop up to six images here. PNG, JPEG or WebP; 8 MiB and 16 megapixels each.
originHint: Optional: own capture, permitted study or source note without private paths.
known: This image is already known to the project.
cancelled: Analysis cancelled. Images remain in the draft.
technicalHint: Colors, lightness, edges and pixel groups are measured locally. They produce editable suggestions, not a confirmed style classification.
semanticHint: Codex can suggest visual characteristics, mood and genre. Interpretation is subjective and requires review. Local analysis works without Codex.
transmission: Only this click sends the {{count}} selected images to Codex and uses your Codex allowance. No image generation.
manualHint: A matching JSON result must contain the image hashes below. Imported claims are attributed to manual input, not to an executed Codex job.
semanticIdle: Semantic analysis has not been requested.
semanticReady: Codex supports image input and structured results.
semanticUnavailable: Visual analysis is unconfirmed for this Codex version or model. Local analysis and JSON import remain available.
semanticNotInstalled: Codex is not installed or not on the application PATH.
semanticNotAuthenticated: Codex requires an existing ChatGPT sign-in. Use ‘codex login’ separately.
semanticRunning: Codex is analyzing the selected references …
semanticCompleted: Semantic analysis completed. Review claims before saving.
semanticFailed: Semantic analysis failed. No result was accepted and nothing was automatically retried.
semanticCancelled: Codex analysis cancelled. Late results are discarded.
name: Suggested style name
technicalDescription: An independent design proposal based on measured color, tonal and edge distributions. Artistic interpretation remains open.
groupedContours: Favor clearly grouped areas and restrained transitions; review outlines at target resolution.
detailedContours: Organize finer transitions deliberately and retain a clear silhouette at target resolution.
clusterProposal: Organize visible pixel or brush groups consistently. Native run lengths are hints, not a confirmed original grid size.
noOriginalResolution: Original virtual resolution cannot be established from these measurements.
shadingProposal: Use coherent tonal groups while allowing additional shadows and material detail.
materialProposal: Simplify materials through areas, transitions and highlight groups without transferring specific clothing.
mutedColors: Use the measured restrained saturation as a starting point. Character-specific colors remain independent.
balancedColors: Use measured color and contrast distributions as a starting point; the working palette does not prescribe skin, hair or clothing colors.
darkTones: Explore a darker tonal balance with readable accents. This does not require a dark background.
openTones: Explore an open tonal balance with controlled accents. Brightness measurements do not identify real light sources or geometry.
compositionProposal: Transfer only general area and detail hierarchies. Framing, pose and background remain decisions for each asset.
positiveRule: Develop a consistent, independent rendering language from reviewed properties.
negativeRule: Do not transfer character identity, specific clothing, logos or recognizable scenes. Do not automatically recolor master palettes.
paletteHint: This palette supports style review. It does not replace a character’s hair, skin or clothing colors.
noSemantic: No semantic analysis available. Mood and genre are not invented from color values.
scopeReviewed: I reviewed the suggestions: independent rendering only, no character identity, outfits, logos or copied scenes.
saved: New style saved. Existing profiles and assignments remain unchanged.
discardConfirm: Discard the unsaved style draft and its temporary references?
reviewHint: Edit or disable individual suggestions. Only Save creates a new profile; existing styles and masters remain unchanged.
noReferences: Add at least one reference image first.
tooMany: At most six reference images. The entire selection was rejected.
duplicateReference: This image is already in the draft.
imageLimits: References: PNG/JPEG/WebP up to 8 MiB and 16 megapixels.
analysisLimit: Local analysis supports up to 4 megapixels per image. Choose a suitable separate reference; no automatic downscaling.
invalidImage: The image could not be fully decoded.
draftExpired: This reference draft is no longer available. Select images again.
referenceMismatch: Analysis and reference hashes or order do not match.
measurementMismatch: Measurements no longer match the reference images. Analyze locally again.
noVisiblePixels: No visible image pixels for a style proposal.
duplicateName: A style with this name already exists. Choose an independent name.
libraryFull: The maximum number of saved profiles or analyses has been reached.
semanticReceiptInvalid: Semantic provenance is not confirmed by this open draft. Import or analyze the result again.
busy: Another image analysis or generation is running. Finish or cancel it first.
noPreview: Text style without a local reference image
sourceDeclared: Saved analysis provenance · imported pack claims are not cryptographically verified.
emptyLibrary: No style saved yet. Start with your reference images.
technicalReady: Local measurements completed. Suggestions are ready for review.
